loop.name: aidlc-full-v1-parent
loop.description: Manual bounded sequential planning, implementation, review/fix, PR/CI, merged QA/rework, closing and ParentReport.

criterion.description: Exact locked checklist id only; never a description or id followed by a colon.

config.question: Check structured facts and child status.
Check structured facts and child status.

expression.jsonata: outputs.planning.value.status = "succeeded" and outputs.planning.value.outcome = "success" and vars.plan.status = "ready" ? "ready" : vars.plan.status = "needs-input" ? "human" : "blocked"

config.question: Check structured facts and child status.
Check structured facts and child status.

expression.jsonata: outputs.review.value.status != "succeeded" or outputs.review.value.outcome != "success" ? "blocked" : vars.review.verdict = "pass" ? "pass" : vars.review.verdict = "changes-required" and vars.reviewCycle < trigger.payload.bounds.reviewCycles ? "fix" : vars.review.verdict = "changes-required" ? "human" : "blocked"

config.question: Check structured facts and child status.
Check structured facts and child status.

expression.jsonata: outputs.qa.value.status != "succeeded" or outputs.qa.value.outcome != "success" ? "blocked" : vars.qa.verdict = "pass" ? "pass" : vars.qa.verdict = "fail" and vars.qaReworks < trigger.payload.bounds.qaReworks ? "rework" : "blocked"
